text: {"messages":[{"time":"09:15","author":"Veikko Vikkelä","role":"Field Engineer","text":"Moi Erkki, I just swapped the SFP on TRN-063 here at OULU-11. The link is up and optics look ok, but all counters are zero and no traffic is passing through."},{"time":"09:17","author":"Erkki Expert","role":"Network Expert","text":"Moi Veikko. This is a known issue with these TX-250 units from 2018. Don't swap the optic again and don't reboot the node."},{"time":"09:18","author":"Erkki Expert","role":"Network Expert","text":"Just do a shut / no shut on the port. It usually wakes up the ASIC."},{"time":"09:21","author":"Veikko Vikkelä","role":"Field Engineer","text":"Okay, let me try that. I did a shut / no shut on the port now."},{"time":"09:22","author":"Veikko Vikkelä","role":"Field Engineer","text":"Yes, it came back! Traffic is flowing now and counters are going up nicely. Thanks! :)"},{"time":"09:24","author":"Erkki Expert","role":"Network Expert","text":"Excellent, good to hear. So the TX-250s of that age do it too, good to know for the future."}]}
